questions.question: Jesus said foxes have dens and birds have nests. What did He say the Son of Man does not have?

answers.text: A place to lay His head

questions.question: When a violent storm filled the disciples' boat with waves, what was Jesus doing?
During a violent storm on the sea, what did the disciples ask Jesus to do when they woke Him?

answers.text: Save them because they were perishing
Turn the boat back toward the shore
Help them bail the water out

questions.question: After Jesus rebuked the winds and the sea during the storm, the water stayed a little rough. True or false?
